description_en: Ignores or cancels ignoring multiple baseline risk items at a time
description_zh: 对基线的风险项批量执行忽略或取消忽略
name: IgnoreHcCheckWarnings

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert that is triggered by the check item. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116182.html operation to query the IDs of alerts that are triggered by check items
parameters.help_zh:
检查项告警ID ，有多个检查项告警ID时使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
检查项告警ID可调用[DescribeCheckWarnings](~~DescribeCheckWarnings~~)接口获取
parameters.name: check_warning_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the check item.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116182.html operation to query the IDs of check items
parameters.help_zh:
基线检查项ID。
基线检查项ID可调用[DescribeCheckWarnings](~~DescribeCheckWarnings~~)接口获取
parameters.name: check_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the risk item that you want to ignore or cancel ignoring.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116179.html operation to query the IDs of risk items
parameters.help_zh:
指定要执行忽略或取消忽略操作的风险项ID。
风险项ID可调用[DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~)接口获取
parameters.name: risk_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the operation that you want to perform. Valid values:

1: ignores a risk item
2: cancels ignoring a risk item
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要执行的操作类型。取值：
1：忽略
2：取消忽略
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The reason for the current operation
parameters.name: reason

parameters.help_en:
The data source. If this parameter is left empty, the server baseline results are queried by default. Valid values:
default: server
agentless
parameters.help_zh:
数据来源，为空时默认查询主机基线结果。取值：
default：主机
agentless：agentless
parameters.name: source

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
